title: Antitumor effects of Cypaliuruside F from Cyclocarya paliurus on HepG2 cells.
authors: Li, Shan-Bin; Zou, Jian; Zhao, Tong-Shi-Yao; Liang, Bin; Wang, Li-Sheng; Huang, Lan-Zhen; Liang, Cheng-Qin; Zhou, Xian-Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物Cypaliuruside F对肝癌细胞的抗肿瘤作用，仅涉及分子对接分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: An undescribed dammarane triterpenoid saponin Cypaliuruside F was isolated from the leaves of Cyclocarya paliurus in our preliminary study. The MTT assay, flow cytometry, cell scratch, and DAPI staining were used to detect the antitumor effects of Cypaliuruside F on HepG2 cells. Subsequently, network pharmacology and molecular docking analysis were used to analyse the key targets of Cypaliuruside F against HCC. In addition, a Western blot was performed to determine the effects of Cypaliuruside F on the expression of key proteins in HepG2 cells. The experimental results indicated that the damarane triterpenoid saponin Cypaliuruside F from Cyclocarya paliurus inhibits the proliferation of HepG2 cells by inducing apoptosis and cell cycle arrest. These changes may promote the apoptosis of HepG2 cells by inhibiting the expression of mTOR, STAT3, and Bcl-2 while activating Bax.
abstract_zh: 在我们初步研究中，从青钱柳（Cyclocarya paliurus）叶片中分离出一种未描述的达玛烷型三萜皂苷Cypaliuruside F。采用MTT法、流式细胞术、细胞划痕实验和DAPI染色检测Cypaliuruside F对HepG2细胞的抗肿瘤作用。随后，利用网络药理学和分子对接分析Cypaliuruside F抗肝细胞癌（HCC）的关键靶点。此外，通过Western blot检测Cypaliuruside F对HepG2细胞中关键蛋白表达的影响。实验结果表明，来自青钱柳的达玛烷型三萜皂苷Cypaliuruside F通过诱导细胞凋亡和细胞周期阻滞抑制HepG2细胞增殖。这些变化可能通过抑制mTOR、STAT3和Bcl-2的表达，同时激活Bax，从而促进HepG2细胞凋亡。
